nodes.name: Bassem Youssef
nodes.description: Egyptian-born comedian, former cardiothoracic surgeon, immigrant who became U.S. citizen in December 2019. Central interview subject of this episode. Source of multiple artifact-backed and testimonial claims regarding Israel, the USS Liberty, and Charlie Kirk.

nodes.name: Phil Turney
nodes.description: USS Liberty survivor, subject of Candace Owens' prior sit-down interview referenced in this episode. According to host, Turney gave her his Purple Heart and cried during the conversation.

nodes.name: Ward Boston
nodes.description: Navy Judge Advocate General who investigated the USS Liberty incident. Per viewer comment A-1694.1, published a notarized statement in the San Diego Union Tribune asserting the investigation was a cover-up and the attack was deliberate.

nodes.name: Victor Ostrovsky
nodes.description: Mossad agent (per Youssef) and author of *By Way of Deception*. Alleged by Youssef to have written in his book that Mossad had advance knowledge of the 1982 Beirut barracks bombing.

nodes.name: Arson Arstrovski
nodes.description: Claimed October 7th survivor. Subject of two on-screen photos (A-1693.1, A-1693.2). Host remarks on authenticity concerns: bandage photo lacks blood despite bloody face.

nodes.name: Rob McCoy
nodes.description: Pastor at Calvary Chapel (per host). Host claims he was purportedly close to Charlie Kirk but that Charlie "couldn't stand him toward the end." Host also claims his father ran psychological operations for the Navy. (Host claim about father is host opinion – not artifact-backed in this episode.)

nodes.name: Piers Morgan
nodes.description: Interviewer; host of the show where Youssef displayed the casualty chart cited in A-1690.1.

nodes.name: USS Liberty Incident Cover-up Investigation
nodes.description: Persistent investigative target across the series. This episode surfaces additional verification material: Ward Boston notarized statement (via viewer) and Victor Ostrovsky book reference. Host also notes New York Times is preparing a USS Liberty piece.

nodes.name: Candace Owens Anti-Semite of Year 2024 Nomination
nodes.description: Persistent series element. In this episode confirmed via opening clip A-1691.1 referencing both her nomination and Tucker Carlson's win.

nodes.name: Piers Morgan Bassem Youssef Chart Numbers Claim
nodes.description: Specific 2014 figures cited by Youssef: 88 Israelis vs. 2,329 Palestinians killed (ratio ~1:27). Plus reference to 7,000 West Bank Palestinians killed since occupation.

nodes.name: Gaza Death Toll and Documentation Claims
nodes.description: Composite node tracking Youssef and Owens' on-record statements about Gaza casualties and the documentation of them.

nodes.name: Andrew Kolvet Charlie Kirk Twitter Control Claim
nodes.description: Youssef states "Charlie didn't run his Twitter feed. Andrew Kovette did." (A-1690 transcript)

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk BB Netanyahu Show Refusal
nodes.description: Per host Candace Owens: "When BB went on a little mini tour and went on everyone's shows sometime in August, Charlie didn't let him on a show." (A-1690 transcript)

nodes.name: New York Times USS Liberty Investigation Reporting
nodes.description: Per host, NYT contacted her regarding her Phil Turney interview and is preparing a piece on USS Liberty.

nodes.name: Arstrovski October 7th Photo Authenticity Question
nodes.description: Discrepancy noted in the two photos: blood on face vs. no blood on bandages.

nodes.name: Bassem Youssef Belly of the Beast Tour Schedule
nodes.description: Documented tour dates: Portland 3/20, Seattle 3/21, plus Philadelphia, DC, Houston, Atlanta.

nodes.name: Victor Ostrovsky *By Way of Deception* 24-Hour Gag Order Claim
nodes.description: Claim that the book was subject to a 24-hour gag order in 1992, described as "the first and last ever gag order on an American book."

nodes.name: 1982 Beirut Barracks Bombing Mossad Advance Knowledge Claim
nodes.description: Per Ostrovsky book (per Youssef): Mossad allegedly knew about the bombing of U.S. Marines in Beirut in advance and withheld information.

nodes.name: *Till Kingdom Come* Documentary Pastors Clip
nodes.description: Verbal reference to documentary showing pastors telling children Jews are more special.

nodes.name: Ward Boston Notarized Statement San Diego Union Tribune
nodes.description: Specific publication reference: Ward Boston's notarized statement was published in the San Diego Union Tribune before his death.

nodes.name: Candace Phil Turney Interview View Count
nodes.description: Approximately 7 million views cited by host, partially corroborated by Project Constitution viewer comment.

nodes.name: Calvary Chapel Church CIA Connection Question
nodes.description: Host claim that Calvary Chapel is "a CIA story" and that Rob McCoy's father ran Navy psychological operations. (Host claim – not artifact-anchored in this episode beyond host testimony.)

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Assassination and TPUSA succession remain the backdrop; host ties elephant-clipping start and Erika drive seed to September 2025.

nodes.name: Candace Owens
nodes.description: Host; target of paid clipping and DoD-adjacent smear; satirizes Candyland nanny comments; organizes tip intake.

nodes.name: Tucker Carlson
nodes.description: SAS Epstein remarks / donor freakout; later hosts Brian Cole parents interview.

nodes.name: Benjamin Netanyahu
nodes.description: July DC visit; Hamptons call offering to take TPUSA “to the next level”; Israel-pressure backdrop.

claims.label: Piers Morgan Chart Cited 2014 Casualty Ratio of ~1:27
claims.claim: Bassem Youssef's Piers Morgan appearance displayed a chart stating that in 2014, 88 Israelis and 2,329 Palestinians were killed, which Youssef described as "one Israeli for 27 Palestinian."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against original Piers Morgan broadcast; cross-check 2014 OCHA/UN OPt casualty figures.

claims.label: Candace Owens Nominated Anti-Semite of Year 2024
claims.claim: Youssef states Candace Owens was nominated for Anti-Semite of the Year 2024 (and did not win).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with Anti-Semite of the Year award organization records.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson Won Anti-Semite of the Year
claims.claim: Per Youssef's show, Tucker Carlson won Anti-Semite of the Year (2025 per context).

claims.label: Ward Boston Notarized Statement on USS Liberty Published in San Diego Union Tribune
claims.claim: Per read-aloud viewer comment, Navy JAG Ward Boston published a notarized statement in the San Diego Union Tribune asserting the USS Liberty investigation was a cover-up and the attack was deliberate.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original San Diego Union Tribune publication and Ward Boston's notarized statement; verify date and text.

claims.label: Candace Owens Phil Turney Interview Received Approximately 7 Million Views
claims.claim: Per host, her Phil Turney interview received approximately 7 million views, prompting New York Times outreach.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify view count via YouTube analytics or platform data.

claims.label: Bassem Youssef US Citizenship in December 2019
claims.claim: Youssef states he took his U.S. citizenship pledge of allegiance in December 2019.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with public records / naturalization records if available.

claims.label: Arstrovski Bandaged October 7th Photo Shows No Blood on Bandages Despite Bloody Face
claims.claim: Per host and displayed image, the bandaged follow-up photo shows no blood on bandages despite blood on face in the prior photo.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original high-resolution images; verify with forensic photo analysis or contextual corroboration.

claims.label: Victor Ostrovsky Book Claims Mossad Had Advance Knowledge of 1982 Beirut Barracks Bombing
claims.claim: Per Youssef's account, *By Way of Deception* by Victor Ostrovsky alleged Mossad knew in advance about the 1982 Beirut barracks bombing (American embassy/Marine bombing).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the book's actual contents against published editions.

claims.label: 24-Hour Gag Order on *By Way of Deception* in 1992
claims.claim: Per Youssef, *By Way of Deception* was subject to a 24-hour gag order in 1992, allegedly the only such order in American literary history.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with publishing industry records and court records.

claims.label: *Till Kingdom Come* Documentary Features Pastors Telling Children Jews Are More Special
claims.claim: Per Youssef, the documentary *Till Kingdom Come* contains clips of pastors addressing children and saying "Jews are better than us. They are more special than us. They are not like us."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the documentary and verify the specific clips and their context.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Did Not Allow Benjamin Netanyahu on Show in August
claims.claim: Per host Candace Owens, Charlie Kirk refused to allow Benjamin Netanyahu on his show in August (referenced as 2025) during Netanyahu's "mini tour" of media appearances.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check with Turning Point USA published guest lists and Netanyahu media tour records.

claims.label: New York Times Preparing a Piece on USS Liberty
claims.claim: Per host, the New York Times contacted her about her Phil Turney interview and is working on a piece regarding USS Liberty.
claims.investigative_direction: Monitor NYT for upcoming USS Liberty coverage.

claims.label: Bassem Youssef Tour Dates Include Portland March 20 and Seattle March 21
claims.claim: Youssef announced Belly of the Beast tour dates: Portland March 20, Seattle March 21, with additional cities Philadelphia, DC, Houston, Atlanta.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify with Youssef's official tour pages and ticketing platforms.
